parameters.help_en: Start Time. UTC time in the format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End time. UTC time in the format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ. The difference between EndTime and StartTime must not exceed 180 days
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。UTC时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。与StartTime相差不超过180天
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
Capability. Default value is understand. Valid values:

- understand: understanding

- understand-reid: understanding with reid

- search: search
parameters.help_zh:
能力。默认understand，取值
- understand 理解
- understand-reid 含reid理解
- search 搜索
parameters.name: capability

parameters.help_en: Page number for paging. Default Value: 1
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en: Page size, which specifies the number of entries displayed per page. Default value is 10, and the maximum value is 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，每页显示条数。默认值为10，最大值为50
parameters.name: page_size
